headline_marked: Over 50,000 cases: [[Dengue cases cross 50,000 mark]] in Bangladesh
headline: Over 50,000 cases: Dengue cases cross 50,000 mark in Bangladesh
summary: Two more deaths were reported in the last 24 hours, bringing the total death toll to 143.
details: At least two dengue patients died and 1,056 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.
The recent deaths were reported in Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) area.
With these new additions, the total number of dengue deaths in the country has risen to 143.
The total number of confirmed dengue cases has now surpassed 50,000, reaching 50,276.
Currently, 3,434 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across the country.
caption:
Dengue cases in Bangladesh have officially crossed the 50,000 mark.

At least two dengue patients died and 1,056 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today.

The recent deaths were reported in Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) area.

With these new additions, the total number of dengue deaths in the country has risen to 143.

The total number of confirmed dengue cases has now surpassed 50,000, reaching 50,276.

Currently, 3,434 dengue patients are receiving treatment at various hospitals across the country.

headline: 24 Awami League members on 10-day remand after Gulshan procession
summary: Police arrested 32 people in connection with a flash procession in Gulshan that involved cocktail explosions and anti-government slogans.
details: A Dhaka court has placed 24 members of the banned Awami League and its affiliate organizations on a 10-day remand. The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Sarah Farzana Haque on Saturday.
caption:
24 Awami League members placed on 10-day remand following a flash procession in Gulshan.

A Dhaka court has placed 24 members of the banned Awami League and its affiliate organizations on a 10-day remand. The order was given by Metropolitan Magistrate Sarah Farzana Haque on Saturday.
